title: Apache Zeppelin console is reachable without authentication
description: The Apache Zeppelin notebook server is served without authentication. Zeppelin notebooks execute code in the language interpreters the server has configured, which for a data deployment means shells against the cluster.
remediation: Enable Zeppelin authentication and shiro authorization, and never expose the notebook server outside the cluster.
limitation: One response body. The rule recognises the Apache Zeppelin console shell from its document title; it does not attempt a login, so it shows that the interface is served, not which data the caller could read.

observation.body: <html><head><title>Sign in · Zeppelin</title></head><body><form method="post" action="/login"><input name="user"><input type="password" name="pass"><button>Sign in</button></form></body></html>
